entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Information element that contains NAS messages, included by the UE when it has pending SMS messages to send in EMM-IDLE mode.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state where the UE is not actively connected to the network.

entities.name: Pending SMS messages to be sent
entities.description: Condition where the UE has SMS messages waiting to be transmitted.

relations.description: The NAS message container IE is included when the UE is in EMM-IDLE mode.
The inclusion of the NAS message container IE is conditioned on the UE having pending SMS messages to send.
